meta.title: DeepSeek Blue Whale Theme
meta.description: Everything theme-related: the DeepSeek-website animated background (aurora, constellation grid, particle whale centred on the main area and following the window; pauses when idle), see-through shell panels with a frosted sidebar, and one liquid-glass material for menus, bubbles, ⌘K search, Settings, dialogs, tool rows, code blocks and file cards, in light and dark; its own Settings › Theme page sets background, whale, grid, idle pause, glass strength and fonts.
